scenarioCoverageAppend.scenario: Workflow dispatch reaches isolated replay without Cargo.lock
scenarioCoverageAppend.expected: The merged develop workflow starts cargo without requiring a tracked Cargo.lock and produces an isolated acceptance-replay receipt.
scenarioCoverageAppend.verificationPlan: Dispatch .github/workflows/acceptance_replay.yml on the merged develop SHA and inspect the completed run and artifact receipt.

scenarioCoverageAppend.scenario: Workflow-only repair preserves replay and decision boundaries
scenarioCoverageAppend.expected: Only the cargo invocation changes; replay lexical, isolation, provenance, notification, and decision assertions remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverageAppend.verificationPlan: Run focused acceptance-replay tests and compare the workflow diff against the Contract out-of-scope boundary.
